instruction: Candid wedding photograph, medium shot. On an indoor stage with purple and white drapes, the groom in a silver shirt (R2) sits on the left, gently applying a tilak to the forehead of the bride in a light green saree (R1) who sits on the right with clasped hands. In the left background, the man in the black shirt (R4) watches. Other blurred guests sit in the background. Warm light glows from out-of-focus brass lamps in the foreground.
